old_knowledge_dedup.boundary: Entity removal versus component unload is already recorded; refresh alone is not a novel mechanism.
Task/listener owner and component unload mismatch already recorded in a historical snapshot.
Timer duplicate names, stop/pause/resume, save/load/transfer and LongUpdate are existing facts; canonical/reviewer_default/hold remains unchanged.
Stewer unload hook omits timer/listener cleanup; default burned path stops before unload. Existing research/restricted/hold remains unchanged.

old_knowledge_dedup.delivery: entry_read; first oversized response was truncated, not counted as complete evidence delivery
old_knowledge_dedup.boundary: Growable explicit stop and unload alias are already recorded; independently checked current source.

review_axes: Bind exact candidate bytes/SHA and frozen source identity before semantic review.
Check each claim, API, mechanism step and source reference, including evidence range hash and exact file member bytes.
Distinguish ctor from postinit and actions registration; check failure windows and lack of local rollback without claiming global exception behavior.
Distinguish RemoveComponent, OnRemoveFromEntity, Remove, OnRemoveEntity, Lua registry cleanup and native Retire/IsValid boundaries.
Trace task helper -> scheduler -> Periodic cancellation/finish; do not equate coroutine tasks or KillTasks with pending timed callbacks.
Check ownership of callback captures separately from task registration owner and validity of each referenced object.
Check update registration, NewUpdatingEnts and deferred stop; compare static and wall paths only where explicitly sourced.
Check callback reentry, self-cancel, remove/re-add and unload during callback; never promise callback rollback or deterministic pairs iteration order.
Compare Timer, Growable and Stewer cleanup as named consumers; do not generalize one component's cleanup to all components.
Trace persistence through explicit component data, not serialization of generic task handles or assumed real-time expiry.
Reject unbounded cross-side/native/concurrency claims; retain research/restricted/hold, runtime_verified:false and dependency_coverage bounds.
Check novelty versus read old atoms and distinguish an added mechanism chain from restated rules or snapshot refresh.

verdict_policy.pass_static: Every claimed contract is accurately bounded and supported; no blocking defects remain; runtime remains unverified.
verdict_policy.request_changes: At least one substantive unsupported, incorrect, overbroad, missing-evidence or non-novel addition remains.
verdict_policy.reject: Candidate cannot be reviewed as bound or materially violates source/distribution/governance scope.
verdict_policy.no_silent_rewrite: Reviewer reports precise defects; author owns candidate edits.

distribution_constraints: Only relative source identifiers, hashes, line locators and original analysis
Necessary old public review dependencies may be packaged with provenance
